up: Retrieve the ChEMBL IDs and canonical SMILES for compounds tested in assays targeting Cytochrome P450 2C9 in humans. Ensure the target organism is Homo sapiens. Return distinct rows for each compound.
sql: SELECT DISTINCT md.chembl_id, cs.canonical_smiles FROM activities a JOIN assays ass ON a.assay_id = ass.assay_id JOIN target_dictionary td ON ass.tid = td.tid JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON a.molregno = md.molregno JOIN compound_structures cs ON md.molregno = cs.molregno WHERE td.pref_name = 'Cytochrome P450 2C9' AND td.organism = 'Homo sapiens'
